attributes.board_name: Tennessee Board for Licensed Professional Counselors, Licensed Marital and Family Therapists, and Licensed Clinical Pastoral Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Graduate course work from accredited institutions (1 semester hour = 10 clock hours); events sponsored or approved by professional associations; events for which an accredited college grants CEUs. Pre-approved providers in rule: AAMFT, AAPC, AASECT, ACA, American Psychiatric Association, APA, NASW and their state affiliates, NBCC, accredited institutions, any state counseling/MFT regulatory agency; others need prior Board approval.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE is required for a profession in the calendar year the license was first approved.
rules.audit_note: Random audits, possibly in consecutive periods; evidence due within 15 working days. Keep proof 4 years from the end of the calendar year it was earned. CE Broker tracking is encouraged but not required.

topics.who: Every two years: professional ethics and/or T.C.A. Title 63 Ch. 22 and Board rules 0450-02

Required under T.C.A. §63-1-125; course from an approved professional association, counseling-credentialing approved course or Board-approved course (Board policy). Hours and interval are not stated on the Board pages read.

rules.notes: 10 clock hours each calendar year (multi-media max 5 per year); license renewal itself is biennial by the birth month ($115). Holders of 2 Board licenses need 15 hours a year, of 3 licenses 20.
